decision_conditions: The proposed development results in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. Furthermore, the applicant fails to  demonstrate that the home will be provided for children and young people who meet this threshold i.e. being a specialist and can demonstrate experience of managing complex young people and those with disabilities, thus would not meet the current needs of LBBD Children’s Social Care, as confirmed by LBBD's Lead Commissioner in Children's Social Care.  As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's supply of family housing and is contrary to the following policies:  National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024);Policies D7, H1, H12 and S2 of the London Plan (March 2021); andPolicies SP3 and SPDG1 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Retrospective application for the demolition of the existing garages and side utility room, relocation of the conservatory door from the side to the rear elevation. The proposed construction of a new two storey 3x bed dwelling and change of use of the dwelling (Use Class C3) to a children's care home (Use Class C2) for up to two child residents supported by two carers on a shift rotation basis alongside a manager
